title: Singapore Stock Market May Extend Losing Streak
text:
Singapore Stock Market May Extend Losing Streak November 20, 2018, 07:00: The Singapore stock market has finished lower in back-to-back trading days, sliding more than 55 points or 1.8 percent along the way. The Straits Times Index now rests just above the 3,025-point plateau and it may take further damage STI finished sharply lower on Tuesday following losses from the financials, industrials and properties.
 dropped 38.08 points or 1.24 percent to finish at 3,026.99 after trading between 3,023.68 and 3,042.94. Volume was 1.44 billion shares worth 925.4 million Singapore dollars.
Among the actives, Yangzijiang Shipbuilding plummeted 3.15 percent, while Comfort DelGro plunged 2.79 percent, Oversea-Chinese Banking Corporation tumbled 2.52 percent, Genting Singapore skidded 2.13 percent, Hutchison Port Holdings jumped 2.00 percent, SembCorp Industries dropped 1.86 percent, Keppel Corporation retreated 1.75 percent, United Overseas Bank declined 1.65 percent, DBA Group contracted 1.29 percent, Thai Beverage shed 0.77 percent, CapitaLand lost 0.64 percent, CapitaLand Mall Trust added 0.46 percent, Ascendas REIT slid 0.39 percent, SingTel fell 0.32 percent, Wilmar International was down 0.31 percent and Golden Agri-Resources and CapitaLand Commercial Trust were unchanged.
